predecessors.name: Kingdom of Polonnaruwa
predecessors.text: the Dambadeniya-Yapahuwa country round Kurunegala (1220) and the south-west, centre and east of the island (1236), the two Cliopatria rows that tile one realm

successors.name: Portuguese Ceylon
successors.text: the Kotte country, which Cliopatria gives to Portuguese Ceylon from 1507

ledger.x: 1220: the Sinhalese kingdom of Dambadeniya rises after the fall of Polonnaruwa.
1236: Parakramabahu II is crowned at Dambadeniya and the realm grows to Cliopatria's first Ceylon shape.
Reign of Parakramabahu II (1236-1270): the north annexed.
1284: the Pandyas take the Tooth Relic.

c. 1309: Pandya control of Sri Lanka ends. The relic passage and the Pandya Empire page ('Pandya control of Sri Lanka lasted until c. 1308-1309'); the Dambadeniya page puts Polonnaruwa as capital 1302-1310. The Dambadeniya page has the relic recovered in 1288 by Parakramabahu III and gives no end to Pandya control…
1314: the north goes to the Jaffna kingdom.
1345: the capital moves from Kurunegala to Gampola.
1352: the plains return from the Jaffna kingdom.
1412: the Gampola kingdom becomes the Kotte kingdom.
1506: Cliopatria's Ceylon row ends and Portuguese Ceylon begins in 1507.

wars.name: Parakramabahu II's war with Kalinga Magha
wars.outcome: Magha is 'pushed out of Polonnaruwa by 1244' and keeps Jaffna.

wars.name: Chandrabhanu's invasion of Dambadeniya
wars.outcome: 'the first one occurred in 1244, led by Chandrabhanu of Tambralinga'; repulsed; Chandrabhanu settled in the north (Jaffna) and later 'launched an invasion to the South' (undated).

wars.name: Pandya invasions of Sri Lanka
wars.outcome: 'a huge Pandyan invasion, launched by Sadayavarman Sundara, occurred sometime between the years 1254 and 1256', Dambadeniya 'not much affected' (Parakramabahu II page); Jaffna becomes a vassal (1258 on the Jaffna lead); the Pandyas capture the Tooth Relic in…

wars.name: Aryacakravarti invasions of Gampola
wars.outcome: 'in appreciation of this victory against the Aryacakravartis in the 1360 Jaffna invasion of Gampola' Nissanka Alagakkonara receives the title Prabhuraja; 'By 1369 Alakesvara drove out the tax collectors' and attacked Jaffna soldiers at Chilaw and Negombo; a…

wars.name: Kotte conquest of the Jaffna kingdom
wars.outcome: Parakramabahu VI conquers Jaffna in 1450 and unifies the island; the Aryacakravarti dynasty is restored in 1467.

wars.name: Rebellion of Senasammata Vikramabahu
wars.outcome: The rebellion 'successfully led' against Kotte in 1469 (Kandy).

certainty.note: Every Sinhalese frontier is approximate; no page gives a boundary, and the shapes follow Cliopatria (the 5,219 km2 Dambadeniya outline is Cliopatria's).
